You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of cloud projects—from architecture and migration to operation and optimization—ensuring that our cloud environments are resilient, efficient, and compliant with industry standards. eligibility_evidence: Your deep understanding of network architecture and security will be essential in building hybrid and multi-cloud environments that meet the highest standards of performance and security.
In addition, a solid understanding of traditional networking concepts—including routing, switching, VLANs, VPN technologies, and hybrid network architectures—is required.
Integrate on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments, implementing Zero-Trust security architectures to safeguard infrastructure.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Your expertise will enable us to develop scalable, secure, and high-availability cloud solutions tailored to our clients' needs. Qualifications To excel in this role, you should possess several years of professional experience as a Cloud Engineer or in a similar capacity, with relevant certifications such as AZ 104 / AZ 305 being highly desirable. You should demonstrate a structured, analytical, and solution-oriented approach, with excellent communication skills in German and good proficiency in English. Responsibilities Design, develop, and document scalable, high-availability cloud architectures in Microsoft Azure that meet client requirements and industry standards.
